basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old software engineer living in Minneapolis. I grew up in Montana, where I developed a passion for fly fishing. After taking a break for a few years due to work commitments, I've recently started getting back into the sport. Besides fishing, I'm a huge fan of martial arts films and often find myself on subreddits related to entertainment and humor. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work and occasionally during lunch breaks. I’m married with two kids, who I sometimes take fishing on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from San Francisco State University. Over the years, I've worked on various software development projects, which has honed my analytical and problem-solving skills. My love for fly fishing comes from my childhood in Montana, where I learned the ropes from my dad and local fishing communities.
